import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/body-size-evolution-in-south-american-freshwater-fishes.csv')
df.head()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df[['BEL_evol', 'MBL_evol', 'OGP_evol', 'RES_evol', 'RML_evol']].values  # Predictor (evolutionary traits)
y = df['BAMM_speciation'].values  # Response (speciation rates)

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_
coefficients

# Recheck the regression analysis
X = df[['BEL_evol', 'MBL_evol', 'OGP_evol', 'RES_evol', 'RML_evol']].values  # Predictor (evolutionary traits)
y = df['BAMM_speciation'].values  # Response (speciation rates)

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_
coefficients

# Perform regression analysis with all variables in the dataset
X = df.drop(columns=['HYBAS_ID', 'long', 'lat', 'BAMM_speciation', 'BAMM_extinction', 'BAMM_NetDiv', 'DR', 'diversity']).values  # Predictor (all variables except response and identifiers)
y = df['BAMM_speciation'].values  # Response (speciation rates)

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_
coefficients

# Check for missing values in the dataset
df.isnull().sum()
